name: Skillset Inview
description: Provides a field type, widget, formatters and a configurable block to display animated skill/proficiency bars for portfolio sites.
project_description:
NEWS! v3 dev is now working base using a custom field. there is no update path from v2 (simply, uninstall v2 before updating to v3 — Param converter is removed).

 
 Provides a block of your key skills with an animated bar graph. animation is triggered when block is 'Inview' of user, resets when out of view.

 
 /admin/content/skillset-inview to add content. Contextual link back to edit page does exist. 
 complete Tabs for review/weighting (drag table), addition, delete 
 /admin/structure/block to place the skillset inview block 
 with HELP module enabled goto /admin/help/skillset_inview 
 
 Bootstrap Grids 
 
 comes with grids ready css classes (at this time you must include by your own means. assuming your theme will use) 
 module provides .tpl for html & css class changes as your theming needs require 
 
 

 
 Drupal 7 Dependencies 
 
 Filter Module | Drupal core 
 elements project 
 libraries (2.x) project 
 jqeasing project 
 the jquery.easing 1.3 library | gsgd.co.uk domain make sure todo file rename [instruction on jqeasing project page] 
 finally; jquery.inview library 
 
 

 
 Drupal 8||9 Dependencies 
 
 Notice: Libraries API NOT needed! direct /libraries access through *.libraries.yml abilities in core 
 jquery.easing 1.3.2 library new download link . 
Into folder: /libraries/jquery.easing 
 jquery.inview . 
Into folder: /libraries/jquery.inview 
 
 

 
 7 vs 8||9 differences: 
 
 Alphabetical Sort button on Overview UI 
 Skillbar Color Tab . Customize colors through UI to match their theme! 
 
 10 differences: 
 
 farbtastic not part of core anymore . farbtastic.js (1.3) | GitHub . 
Into folder: /libraries/farbtastic/farbtastic.min.js 
 and rest of contents.
